regions.label: Credit decoder
regions.note: Subtracts 4, 5, 6 and so on from the 65 bytes at 01ABh.

regions.label: Slide player
regions.note: Sets EGA mode 10h, copies each 9-byte header into its own code, and plots every pixel twice through the BIOS.

regions.label: Scrambled credit
regions.note: "K E M Y A M Software Corp., <c>1991 YASSER MOHAMED ALI." after decoding, shown at the end.

regions.label: Slide script
regions.note: 15 slides, 23 lines of text, 9,023 vertical pixel runs and the commands x, w, y, z and 88h.

regions.label: Tail
regions.note: Nine more z bytes and 1Ah, the DOS end-of-file mark; the player stops at the first z.

lines.note: EGA mode 10h, which also clears the screen
